items.title: 11.3 Reaction mechanism and modes of bond breaking (bond tootne ke tareeqe) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.3 with Figures 11.5 and 11.6, printed pages 251-252.

blocks.text: Reaction mechanism un steps (qadmon) ki series (silsila) hai jo poori reaction ke dauran hote hain. Tamam chemical reactions ki tarah organic reactions mein bhi chemical bonds toot-te hain. Covalent bond do tarah se toot sakta hai.
Homolytic fission (barabar tootna) us waqt hoti hai jab covalent bond barabar toot-ta hai, yani bond ke do electrons mein se aik aik dono atoms ko milta hai, aur free radicals bante hain.

blocks.title: Free Radical
blocks.text: Free radical woh species (atom ya atoms ka group) hai jis mein aik unpaired (akela, bina jore ka) electron ho; yeh bohat reactive hota hai.
Free radicals bohat zyada reactive hote hain kyunke unpaired electron jora (pair) banana chahta hai.

blocks.alt: Box mein 'Homolytic Cleavage'. A-B: bond se do half-headed (aadhe sir wale, fish-hook) teer, har atom ki taraf ek, phir 'Homolysis' wala teer A. + B. tak, 'Free radicals'. Neeche: Cl-Cl do fish-hook teeron ke saath, hv wala teer, Cl. + Cl., 'Free radicals'.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.5: Homolytic fission aur free radicals ka banna (kitab ki Figure 11.5 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Half-headed (fish-hook) teer sirf aik electron ki movement (harkat) dikhata hai. Homolysis mein bond ke do electrons mein se aik A ke paas aur aik B ke paas jata hai, is liye dono par aik akela (unpaired) electron reh jata hai: yeh free radicals hain. Cl–Cl roshni (hν) se isi tarah do Cl• deta hai.

Heterolytic fission (ghair barabar tootna) us waqt hoti hai jab covalent bond is tarah toote ke bond ka shared electron pair sirf aik atom ko mil jaye, aur opposite charge wale ions (aik positive, aik negative) bante hain. Mechanisms mein yeh bond tootna full-headed (poore sir wale) curly teer se dikhaya jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein ‘oppositely child ions’ chhapa hai, jo chhapai ki ghalti hai. Sahi lafz ‘oppositely charged ions’ hai, yani opposite charge wale ions.

blocks.alt: Box mein 'Heterolytic cleavage'. A-B: bond ka electron jora circle (daira) mein, us se B tak poora curly teer, result (nateeja) A+ aur :B-. Neeche: H3C-Cl, Cl par teen lone pairs, C-Cl bond se Cl tak curly teer; result H3C+ ion aur chaar lone pairs wala chloride ion :Cl:-.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.6: Heterolytic fission aur ions ka banna (kitab ki Figure 11.6 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Poora curly teer electron pair (do electrons) ki movement dikhata hai. Dono electrons Cl ke paas chale jate hain, is liye Cl par negative charge aata hai aur carbon par positive charge reh jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 11.6 ki caption mein ‘formation of radical ions’ likha hai. Heterolytic fission se ions bante hain (carbocation aur chloride ion), radicals nahi, is liye sahi ‘formation of ions’ hai.

blocks.prompt: Homolytic aur heterolytic fission mein farq batayein (exercise Q.2b).
blocks.explanation: Homolytic fission mein shared pair barabar bant-ta hai, har tukre ko aik electron milta hai aur unpaired electron wale neutral free radicals bante hain, jaise roshni se chlorine ka tootna. Heterolytic fission mein dono electrons zyada electronegative atom ke paas jate hain aur cation aur anion bante hain; is ko poore curly teer se dikhate hain.

rows: har atom ko shared pair ka aik electron milta hai
dono electrons aik (zyada electronegative) atom ko milte hain
neutral free radicals bante hain (unpaired electron)
opposite charge wale ions bante hain (cation aur anion)
full curly teer se dikhate hain

items: Mechanism = reaction ke steps. Homolytic fission: bond barabar toot kar free radicals (unpaired electron, bohat reactive). Heterolytic fission: dono electrons aik atom ko, opposite charge wale ions (poora curly teer).
